concept.title: Runway Walk, Leaf Edition
concept.hook: A medium dog in a mustard pom-pom beanie trots straight at the lens on a leaf-covered path, pom-pom bouncing in slow motion. On-screen line: Your dog called. He wants a sweater.
concept.surpriseBeat: Mid-trot, the dog stops dead on the path, sits, and turns its head to the side like a model hitting a pose, as if the walk was a runway.

locations.description: Sidewalk park path covered in fallen leaves, bare-edged trees in soft background
locations.lighting: Low golden sun, warm highlights, soft creamy shadows

locations.description: Plain wooden tabletop for the final locked-off product frame
locations.lighting: Soft warm window light from the side

scenes.action: A medium dog wearing the mustard knit beanie with pom-pom trots toward the camera, ears poking through the ear openings, pom-pom bouncing in slow motion.
scenes.framing: Pet eye level, medium shot, shallow depth of field, 35mm look
scenes.motion: Steady confident trot, leaves kicking up lightly behind
scenes.lighting: Low golden sun, warm rim light on the yarn
scenes.overlayText: Your dog called. He wants a sweater.
scenes.sound: Leaves crunching, light paws, upbeat indie pop starts with plucked acoustic guitar

scenes.action: Macro of the beanie knit and the adjustable strap resting under the dog's chin as it keeps walking.
scenes.framing: Close-up on the knit texture and strap, steady handheld, no label text
scenes.motion: Dog's head gently bobbing, yarn stretching around the ears
scenes.lighting: Warm golden backlight with soft shadow
scenes.dialogue: Soft stretch yarn. Adjustable straps. Runway ready.
scenes.sound: Soft hand claps join, light glockenspiel

scenes.action: A small dog in a matching knit bandana trots into frame beside the beanie dog, both walking along the leaf path side by side.
scenes.framing: Two dogs at eye level, medium wide, shallow focus on the leaves
scenes.motion: Both dogs trot in step, bandana fluttering slightly
scenes.sound: Bouncy bass groove, paws on leaves

scenes.action: The beanie dog stops, sits, and turns its head sideways in a mock-serious model pose while the small dog trots past.
scenes.framing: Tight on the dog's face and beanie, pom-pom sharp
scenes.motion: Dog sits abruptly and holds still, pom-pom swaying then settling
scenes.lighting: Warm sun, soft creamy shadow on the far side
scenes.sound: Music pauses for one beat, small whistle hook

scenes.action: Final locked-off frame of the mustard beanie with pom-pom, the knit bandana and the rust-red sweater folded on a wooden surface.
scenes.framing: Locked-off, slightly above, products centered and fully visible
scenes.motion: Still frame, one soft settle of a pom-pom
scenes.lighting: Soft warm window light, light film grain
scenes.overlayText: $24. Machine washable. New colors each season. Shop now.
scenes.dialogue: Twenty-four dollars. New colors each season. Come shop.
scenes.sound: Music resolves with a final glockenspiel note

rubric.reason: Clear delight and a strong slow-motion pom-pom hook. The model-pose stop is charming but predictable, and the product is worn rather than shown being put on.

concept.title: Zero Regrets
concept.hook: Cat in an empty rust-red sweater held open on a window seat, the cat calmly walks toward it. On-screen line: Cat in a sweater: zero regrets, full confidence.
concept.surpriseBeat: The cat steps into the sweater with total calm, while the dog beside it in the beanie flinches at the strap click, reversing who is the drama queen.

locations.description: Sunlit apartment living room with a wide window seat and cushions
locations.lighting: Soft sunlight through the window, warm and creamy

locations.description: Plain wooden surface for the final locked-off frame
locations.lighting: Soft warm window light from the side

scenes.action: A rust-red knit sweater lies open on the window seat. A short-haired cat walks up and stands still in front of it.
scenes.framing: Cat eye level, shallow depth of field, sweater and cat in frame
scenes.motion: Cat pads forward slowly and pauses, tail upright
scenes.lighting: Soft morning window light, golden highlights
scenes.overlayText: Cat in a sweater: zero regrets, full confidence.
scenes.sound: Quiet room tone, plucked acoustic guitar begins

scenes.action: The cat steps calmly through the sweater opening, the stretch yarn giving as it walks through.
scenes.framing: Low medium shot at cat eye level, steady handheld
scenes.motion: One paw then the next, the knit stretching and settling over the back
scenes.sound: Soft hand claps, gentle bass groove

scenes.action: The dog sits beside the window seat while a hand eases the mustard beanie over its head and through the ear openings, then clicks the adjustable strap.
scenes.framing: Eye-level on the dog, hand entering late from the side, label clear of hands
scenes.motion: Dog sits patiently, ears pop through the openings

scenes.action: The cat sits in the window seat in the sweater, unbothered, while the dog beside it tilts its beanie head at the cat.
scenes.framing: Two-shot of cat and dog on the window seat, locked off
scenes.motion: Cat blinks slowly, dog tilts head, pom-pom flops
scenes.overlayText: Meet the most dressed ones in the house.
scenes.dialogue: Meet the most dressed ones in the house.
scenes.sound: Music pauses a beat, small whistle hook

scenes.action: Final locked-off frame of the rust-red sweater and mustard beanie folded on a wooden surface.
scenes.framing: Straight down, products centered and fully visible
scenes.dialogue: Twenty-four dollars. Machine washable. Come shop.
scenes.sound: Music resolves on a bouncy final chord

rubric.reason: Shows the brief's real putting-on routine and the cat stepping in, so the product is clearly used. The surprise is gentle, and the dog and cat gag adds a second small beat.

concept.title: From Wash to Wardrobe
concept.hook: A rust-red sweater tumbles in a front-loading washer drum in the first second. On-screen line: Meet the most dressed one in the house.
concept.surpriseBeat: The washer door opens and the sweater is revealed already folded beside the pom-pom beanie, followed by the cat strolling in to claim the stack.

locations.description: Small laundry nook with a front-loading washer and a wooden shelf
locations.lighting: Soft warm light from a nearby window

locations.description: Sunlit apartment living room with a wide window seat

scenes.action: The rust-red sweater turns slowly inside the washer drum, seen through the round glass door.
scenes.framing: Locked-off close shot of the drum, sweater shape clear
scenes.motion: Slow drum rotation, sweater tumbling gently
scenes.lighting: Warm nook light with a soft glow on the glass
scenes.overlayText: Meet the most dressed one in the house.
scenes.sound: Soft washer hum, upbeat indie pop intro with plucked guitar

scenes.action: The short-haired cat sits on the washer top watching the drum, wearing the same rust-red sweater.
scenes.framing: Cat eye level, shallow depth of field, drum blurred behind
scenes.motion: Cat's head follows the spinning drum
scenes.lighting: Warm window light with creamy shadow

scenes.action: The medium dog trots across the living room in the mustard pom-pom beanie, ending at the window seat.
scenes.framing: Eye-level tracking, pom-pom bounce in slow motion
scenes.motion: Trot, pom-pom bounce, stretch yarn moving with the head
scenes.sound: Bouncy bass groove, paws on floor

scenes.action: Back at the laundry nook, the washer door opens and the sweater and pom-pom beanie sit folded on the shelf. The cat strolls in and settles on the stack.
scenes.framing: Starts on the folded stack, pulls back to reveal the nook and cat
scenes.motion: Cat steps onto the stack and curls up
scenes.sound: Music pauses a beat, whistle hook

scenes.action: Final locked-off frame of the folded sweater, beanie and bandana on a wooden surface.
scenes.framing: Locked-off, products fully visible and centered
scenes.lighting: Soft warm light, light film grain
scenes.overlayText: $24. New colors each season. Shop now.
scenes.dialogue: Twenty-four dollars. New colors each season. Come shop.

rubric.reason: The washer hook is distinctive and uses the brief's closing beat early. It is quieter than the others, and the cat appearing in a sweater inside the nook while the sweater washes needs care in the edit.
